stage33_superseded.reason: Stage8 studies X1 (R-STAGE8-SCOPE: A01 implementation forbidden); its J_plus12/J_minus12 values are X1 jack-board currents, so Stage33 mislabelled them as A01-jack. The AGND bound summed rail-to-rail currents and put all return on J-PWR pin 4. Stage33 bytes stay unchanged as history.
